title: betula lutea var. genuina
intro: Betula lutea var. genuina, commonly known as Yellow Birch, is a plant species native to North America. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin problems, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Yellow Birch include antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral properties, which contribute to its healing effects. The bioactive constituents of Yellow Birch include salicin, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
